prompt: Write a SLURM batch script named hello.sh that runs a single serial task on one node. Give the job the name 'hello', request at most 10 minutes of walltime and 512MB of memory. The script must print exactly the line ANVIL_OK to standard output.

Write a SLURM batch script for a single multithreaded task on one node using exactly 4 CPU cores. Export OMP_NUM_THREADS so it matches the allocated cores, request 30 minutes and 2GB of memory, and print the value of OMP_NUM_THREADS prefixed by 'THREADS='. The script must also print ANVIL_OK.

Write a SLURM job array script that runs 5 independent tasks indexed from 1 to 5. Each array task should print 'TASK=' followed by its array index. Request 15 minutes per task and 1GB of memory. Also print ANVIL_OK. Make sure the script still runs correctly when SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID is not set, defaulting to 1.

Write a SLURM batch script that sends standard output to logs/out_%j.txt and standard error to logs/err_%j.txt, creating the logs directory first if it does not exist. Name the job 'io_test', request 20 minutes and 1GB. Print ANVIL_OK to stdout.

Write a SLURM batch script that requests 1 GPU on a single node, with 8 CPU cores, 16GB of memory and a walltime of 2 hours. The script should echo the value of CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES prefixed by 'GPUS=' (an empty value is acceptable) and print ANVIL_OK.

Write a SLURM batch script for an MPI job spanning 2 nodes with 4 tasks in total, 30 minutes of walltime and 4GB of memory. Do not actually invoke mpirun; instead print 'RANKS=' followed by the value of the SLURM_NTASKS environment variable, defaulting to 4 if unset. Print ANVIL_OK.

Write a SLURM batch script named stage2.sh that is meant to run after another job completes successfully. It must declare a job name 'stage2', request 25 minutes and 2GB, and set the SLURM dependency directive so that it only starts after job 12345 has completed successfully. Print ANVIL_OK.

Write a SLURM batch script that runs a command inside an Apptainer container image located at /opt/images/app.sif, binding the host directory /scratch/data to /data inside the container. Request 1 node, 1 task, 45 minutes and 8GB. Guard the apptainer invocation so that if the apptainer binary is not available the script prints 'NO_APPTAINER' and still exits with status 0. Print ANVIL_OK.
